annotations.title: Get counts of NSW development applications by status, application type and council.

description: Get counts of NSW development applications by status, application type and council. Call it before nsw_da_search_applications or nsw_da_search_nearby_applications: it returns the total loaded and by_status, by_application_type and by_council lists of { key, count }, whose keys are the exact filter values those tools accept. Filters are optional and combine with AND; without them the counts cover all of NSW. Counts refresh every 6 hours while the history backfill extends coverage back to 2021. Free, no payment needed. Source: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure (NSW Planning Portal), CC BY 4.0.

application_type.description: Application type, exact and case-sensitive; valid values are the keys of by_application_type in nsw_da_get_summary (e.g. Development Application)

council.description: Council name or part of it, case-insensitive; matches every council whose name contains it. Full names are in by_council of nsw_da_get_summary (e.g. Parramatta)

status.description: Application status, exact and case-sensitive; valid values are the keys of by_status in nsw_da_get_summary (e.g. Determined)

name: nsw_da_get_summary

attribution.description: Source attribution; keep it when presenting the data

text.description: Attribution text to show alongside the data

data.description: Result: a list of applications for search and nearby tools, one record or summary object otherwise

meta.description: Paging and query details, e.g. limit, offset, has_more, count

title: Get counts of NSW development applications by status, application type and council.
